scope: Windows test harness only. No production guard source, defaults, protection, process hierarchy, creation flags or deadlines changed. No full readiness or performance result.
problems: Native test-output readers treated read errors as EOF and ignored incomplete/disconnected completion; ordinary Out could conceal a capture failure.
Competitor version staging parsed matching text without checking the original native exit, and restored an assumed error preference.
behavior: Only EOF on both streams permits ordinary Out. Interrupted reads retry; read faults, receive timeouts and disconnected completion fail capture.

Both stream captures are collected before refusal. Raw writes of retained partial bytes to existing harness streams are attempted, with separate completion/count/native-status and write-error diagnostics; keep_stdout=false intentionally retains only its count.
Version probes clear stale native status, capture it immediately, reject absent/nonzero/collection-failure results before parsing or staging, and restore the exact saved preference in finally.

grouped_reader_cases: binary prefix then EOF, count only
binary prefix then synthetic io::Error with raw OS code5
real reader panic then disconnected completion, retaining prefix
paused reader timeout, release and source-drop notification under the original five-second fixture bound

retained_failed_preparation.phase: Before capture reservation or any version fixture
retained_failed_preparation.error: Windows PowerShell could not autoload Get-FileHash in the inherited module environment.
retained_failed_preparation.correction: Fresh controller selects pinned Windows-native Utility files through a local absolute import, after streaming .NET hash verification. No module-path, profile, system configuration or shared-runtime reset.

limits: The IO fault is injected through Read; this is not evidence of a naturally occurring Windows ReadFile fault.
The exec_with failure diagnostic raw-write/native-status branch is source-reviewed, not separately fault-injected end to end.

Receive waits retain their existing ten-second bound per stream. Mutex acquisition and diagnostic writes rely on the finite enclosing process deadline; no reader cancellation or OS-thread join is promised.
Source-drop notification is not an OS-thread-signaled observation. The intentional reader panic appears in retained stderr and is expected.
The existing child-timeout branch remains unchanged and still fails before output draining; this patch does not add partial-output preservation on that path.
The version qualification executes the exact harness segment only; no real competitor build/staging or product payload is qualified.
Raw machine/tooling records remain private; these summaries do not replace the outstanding public reproduction package.
